title: We're Hiring!
body:
Our first project grant means we are able to bring on external support. Read on for details...

# **Programme Producer, Community Technology Fellowship**

**Freelance · January–March 2027 · London
One day a week · £16ph/ 128 per day · 12 days in total

**
With the possibility of an extension until July 2027.

Full job description, [here](https://www.image2url.com/r2/default/documents/1794654506304-62b661d7-93ca-49cb-b45a-6130aece77bf.pdf)

Summary:

- - -

## **About the fellowship**

Our Community Technology Fellowship will support three people through a dedicated period of research and development, each working towards a tool that supports a community they belong to. Fellows will receive mentorship, workshops and production support, with a final showcase to share their work.

From January to March, your focus will be on getting the programme ready: coordinating facilitators, supporting the open call and selection process, researching venues, and setting up the systems that help things run smoothly.

Depending on programme needs and how we find working together, there may be an opportunity to extend the contract to support fellowship sessions and the final showcase between April and July.

- - -

##   **What you’ll be doing**

* Setting up a shared programme workspace, schedule and task tracker.
* Keeping track of deadlines and following up on agreed actions.
* Researching and coordinating bookings for venues, including the final showcase.
* Liaising with guest facilitators about availability, session details and practical arrangements.
* Drafting programme copy and supporting outreach for the fellowship open call.
* Managing application records and responding to applicant questions.
* Supporting longlisting, arranging interviews and helping welcome the selected fellows.
* Keeping clear records of your time and flagging where priorities need adjusting to fit the available hours.

This is a one-day-a-week role, so we’ll agree priorities together and keep the workload realistic.

- - -

##  **How to Apply**

Please read the full job description, then complete the application form [here](https://tally.so/r/o9e1pb), or if the hyperlink is not working for any reason, visit: <https://tally.so/r/o9e1pb> 

Alongside your name, contact details and CV, we’ll ask you to answer two short questions, either in prose or bullet points.

1. Tell us about a project, programme or event you helped bring together. What was your role, how did you keep things organised, and how did you help the people involved feel informed and supported? 

Examples from paid work, volunteering or community organising are all welcome.

1. What draws you to Future Inventions and this programme?

You’ll also be asked to confirm your availability for the January–March contract and Friday working arrangements.

If you have any questions or need an adjustment to the application or interview process, please contact @futureinventions.lab@gmail.com

## **Key dates**

* **Applications close:** Friday 4 December 2026
* **Interviews:** Friday 11 December 2026
* **Start date:** Friday 8 January 2027
